Strategy: Reward absolute leftovers between twenty-eight and forty-two, and penalize leftovers between six and twenty, a nearby variation of the strong thirty-to-forty-five band. It may help by fine-tuning the band edges, but may fail if the exact edges matter more than the band idea itself.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) - (25 if r - item >= 6 and r - item <= 20 else 0) for r in bins]
```
